chunks.l2:
[tsa-a06-v01] It itself is called by the word seat-fixing. There the seat is threefold — breath-wind, body, and the outer. There first the method in breath: all that course to be stated is reckoned as resting in breath; of it, counting in sequence and non-sequence alone is time. And it shines within the Supreme Lord alone; its shining is the God's power named Kālī; but with division, its appearing in sequence and non-sequence is breath-movement.

[tsa-a06-v10] Two fingers and a quarter is called tuṭi; in four of them a watch; half tuṭi, half tuṭi — there twilight. Thus in going out day, in coming in night: thus the lunar-day rise.

[tsa-a06-v12] There day is the dark fortnight, night the bright. There the first half-tuṭi and the last half-tuṭi are untimed rest; but the middle fifteen alone are tuṭis, lunar days. There light is rest and — thus these alone are day and night.

[tsa-a06-v13] There the light of knowable-ness is day; of the knowable in the dissolver, dissolution is night. And they — light and rest, through quick-slow variety in endless difference; in sameness with that, equinox.

[tsa-a06-v14] There in the dark fortnight, in the breath-sun, the in-breath-moon offers each single fattening digit, until on the fifteenth, in the tuṭi near the twelve-end, the moon whose digit-spread has thinned and separated dissolves into the breath-sun alone.

[tsa-a06-v15] Right after that, what half-tuṭi there is — that is the fortnight-joint.

[tsa-a06-v16] And of it, of the half-tuṭi, the eastern half is new-moon, the second first-day.

[tsa-a06-v17] There on the first-day, in that part, when, from cough-effort-attention-made tithi-cutting, it enters — then there is seizure. And there the Māyā-knower-Rāhu, co-born with the object-moon — by nature unable to dissolve, merely capable of covering — drinks the lunar nectar gone to the sun.

[tsa-a06-v02] For consciousness itself takes a form apart from its objects; hence indeed, through being bounded, going to knowability: the void. Then through freedom, falling on the object with eagerness to seize, action-power-led, breathing-formed, living-natured — since with five forms it fills the body, then it shines as if conscious.

[tsa-a06-v03] There in power, action is the time-course; in the eastern part, but in the northern, of varied form, is the place-course; there, of letter, mantra, and word courses, the standing in time-course, through beyond-subtle-gross-formedness.

[tsa-a06-v04] But the standing of the place-course, as tattva-person-ray-natured — thus it will be in its own place.

[tsa-a06-v05] There, though even in the body, with outer and inner, breath is warp-and-woof-formed — yet of distinctly sensible effort, that, from the heart beginning — thus from that alone this is to be described.

[tsa-a06-v06] There lord-power, self-power, and effort — thus a triad — are the cause in driving breath, through secondary-primary states.

[tsa-a06-v07] There, from the heart to the twelve-end's end, by one's own fingers, of all is the thirty-six-fingered breath-course, in going out and in coming in, since of each is fitted strength, effort, and body.

[tsa-a06-v08] There the water-clock, the lunar day, the month, the year, and as year-group-natured — thus the entire time is completed. There, in the finger and a fifth, the finger, caṣaka — thus by the rule is the ghaṭikā-rise; for a ghaṭikā is by sixty caṣakas; hence seventy-two-fingered it is.
chunks.sanskrit:
tantrasāra, ṣaṣṭham āhnikam sa eva sthānaprakalpanaśabdena uktaḥ tatra tridhā sthānaṃ prāṇavāyuḥ śarīraṃ bāhyaṃ ca tatra prāṇe tāvat vidhiḥ sarvaḥ asau vakṣyamāṇaḥ adhvā prāṇasthaḥ kalyate tasya kramākramakalanaiva kālaḥ sa ca parameśvara eva antarbhāti tadbhāsanaṃ ca devasya kālī nāma śaktiḥ bhedena tu tadābhāsanaṃ kramākramayoḥ prāṇavṛttiḥ // abhts_6.1 saṃvid eva hi prameyebhyo vibhaktaṃ rūpaṃ gṛhṇāti ata eva ca avacchedayogāt vedyatāṃ yāntī nabhaḥ tataḥ svātantryāt meye svīkārautsukyena nipatantī kriyāśaktipradhānā prāṇanārūpā jīvasvabhāvā pañcabhī rūpaiḥ dehaṃ yataḥ pūrayati tato 'sau cetana iva bhāti // abhts_6.2 tatra kriyā śaktau kālādhvā prācyabhāge uttare tu mūrtivaicitryarūpo deśādhvā tatra varṇamantrapadādhvanaḥ kālādhvani sthitiḥ parasūkṣmasthūlarūpatvāt // abhts_6.3 deśādhvasthitis tu tattvapurakalātmanā iti bhaviṣyati svāvasare // abhts_6.4 tatra yady api dehe sabāhyābhyantaram otaprotarūpaḥ prāṇaḥ tathāpi prasphuṭasaṃvedyaprayatnaḥ asau hṛdayāt prabhṛti iti tata eva ayaṃ nirūpaṇīyaḥ // abhts_6.5 tatra prabhuśaktiḥ ātmaśaktiḥ yatna iti tritayaṃ prāṇeraṇe hetuḥ guṇamukhyabhāvāt // abhts_6.6 tatra hṛdayāt dvādaśāntāntaṃ svāṅgulaiḥ sarvasya ṣaṭtriṃśadaṅgulaḥ prāṇacāraḥ nirgame praveśe ca svocitabalayatnadehatvāt sarvasya // abhts_6.7 tatra ghaṭikā tithiḥ māso varṣaṃ ca varṣasamūhātmā iti samastaḥ kālaḥ parisamāpyate /
tatra sapañcāṃśe aṅgule caṣaka iti sthityā ghaṭikodayaḥ ghaṭikā hi ṣaṣṭyā caṣakaiḥ tasmāt dvāsaptatyaṅgulā bhavati // abhts_6.8 atha tithyudayaḥ // abhts_6.9 sapādam aṅguladvayaṃ tuṭiḥ ucyate tāsu catasṛṣu praharaḥ tuṭyardhaṃ tuṭyardhaṃ tatra saṃdhyā evaṃ nirgame dinaṃ praveśe rātriḥ iti tithyudayaḥ // abhts_6.10 atha māsodayaḥ // abhts_6.11 tatra dinaṃ kṛṣṇapakṣaḥ rātriḥ śuklaḥ tatra pūrvaṃ tuṭyardham antyaṃ ca tuṭyardhaṃ viśrāntiḥ akālakalitāḥ madhyās tu pañcadaśa tuṭaya eva tithayaḥ tatra prakāśo viśrāntiś ca iti ete eva dinaniśe // abhts_6.12 tatra vedyamayatāprakāśo dinaṃ vedyasya vicārayitari layo rātriḥ te ca prakāśaviśrāntī cirāciravaicitryāt anantabhede tatsāmye tu viṣuvat // abhts_6.13 tatra kṛṣṇapakṣe prāṇārke apānacandra āpyāyikām ekām ekāṃ kalām arpayati yāvat pañcadaśyāṃ tuṭau dvādaśāntasamīpe kṣīṇapṛthagbhūtakalāprasaraḥ candramāḥ prāṇārka eva līyate // abhts_6.14 tadanantaraṃ yat tuṭyardhaṃ sa pakṣasaṃdhiḥ // abhts_6.15 tasya ca tuṭyardhasya prācyam ardham āmāvasyaṃ dvitīyaṃ prātipadam // abhts_6.16 tatra prātipade tasmin bhāge sa āmāvasyo bhāgo yadā kāsaprayatnāvadhānādikṛtāt tithicchedāt viśati tadā tatra grahaṇam tatra ca vedyarūpasomasahabhūto māyāpramātṛrāhuḥ svabhāvatayā vilāpanāśaktaḥ kevalam ācchādanamātrasamarthaḥ sūryagataṃ cāndram amṛtaṃ pibati iti // abhts_6.17

chunks.l2:
[tsa-a06-v18] Since making the knower-measure-known triad non-divided, that time is holy, other-world-fruit-giving.

[tsa-a06-v19] Then, entering breath, the awareness-sun with each single digit fills the in-breath-moon, until the fifteenth tuṭi is full moon; right after, fortnight-joint and seizure — thus as before. But this is this-world-fruit-giving: thus the month rise.

[tsa-a06-v21] There the dark fortnight alone is the northern course; in six and six fingers is the passage, from Capricorn up to Gemini's end.

[tsa-a06-v22] There per finger five lunar days; even there day-and-night division. Thus in coming in the southern course — womb-ness, birth-wish, about-to-be-born-ness, will-be-born-ness, birth-beginning, being-born-ness, birth-and-six-changes — thus in order among Capricorn and the rest.

[tsa-a06-v23] Just so worship here does fitting fruit.

[tsa-a06-v24] And here Dakṣa and the rest up to Grandfather, Rudras and powers — twelve lords: thus the year rise.

[tsa-a06-v25] Per finger sixty lunar days, thus in order at passage a year — thus by this order, in coming and going, twelve-year rise. Per finger of lunar days three hundred in finger-and-a-fifth — a year where before caṣaka was said: thus by counting, at passage five years — thus by this series, in one breath-out-in time sixty-year rise. Here twenty-one thousand six hundred: thus of lunar days the number.

[tsa-a06-v26] That many alone in day and night is the breath-count: thus not beyond sixty-year rise is examined, from endlessness.

[tsa-a06-v27] There the human year is the gods' lunar day; by this order twelve thousand divine years are four ages.

[tsa-a06-v28] Four, three, two, one — thus from kṛta beginning, by so many hundreds, eight twilights.

[tsa-a06-v29] By seventy-one four-ages a manu-period; by fourteen manu-periods Brahmā's day. At Brahmā-day's end, in the triple world burnt by time-fire, and elsewhere in the triple world smoke-lulled, all people swiftly, fire-driven, in people-world having become pralaya-kevalas, stand.

[tsa-a06-v30] But awakened Kūṣmāṇḍa, Hāṭakeśa and the rest play in the great world.

[tsa-a06-v31] Then at night's end Brahmā's emission.

[tsa-a06-v32] By this measure a hundred years is Brahmā-lifespan.

[tsa-a06-v33] That is Viṣṇu's day, and that much the night; of him too a hundred is the lifespan.

[tsa-a06-v34] That day; above that, O Rudra-world-lord, Rudra's; that much night; as before a year. That hundred too — and the limit.

[tsa-a06-v35] There at Rudra's end, going to Śiva-ness; Rudra's stated office-limit. Of world-egg bearers that day; of a hundred Rudras night that much; of them too a hundred is the lifespan.

[tsa-a06-v36] When a hundred Rudras end — world-egg destruction.

[tsa-a06-v37] Thus from water-principle up to the unmanifest, this alone in order is the Rudras' lifespan.

[tsa-a06-v38] The earlier's lifespan is the later's day: thus.

[tsa-a06-v39] And then Brahmā and Rudras are unobstructed officers standing in the unmanifest: thus.

[tsa-a06-v40] And then Śrīkaṇṭha-lord is the withdrawer.

[tsa-a06-v41] This is intermediate dissolution; on its ending, emission.

[tsa-a06-v42] There other scriptures, stated, too are emitted.

[tsa-a06-v43] But Śrīkaṇṭha-lord's own lifespan — that is the sheath-dwellers' Rudras' day, that much the night; their lifespan — that is Gahaneśa-day, that much alone the night; and in her the entire alone dissolves in Māyā.
chunks.sanskrit: pramātṛpramāṇaprameyatritayāvibhāgakāritvāt sa puṇyaḥ kālaḥ pāralaukikaphalapradaḥ // abhts_6.18 tataḥ praviśati prāṇe cidarka ekaikayā kalayā apānacandram āpūrayati yāvat pañcadaśī tuṭiḥ pūrṇimā tadanantaraṃ pakṣasaṃdhiḥ grahaṇaṃ ca iti prāgvat etat tu aihikaphalapradam iti māsodayaḥ // abhts_6.19 atha varṣodayaḥ // abhts_6.20 tatra kṛṣṇapakṣa eva uttarāyaṇaṃ ṣaṭsu ṣaṭsu aṅguleṣu saṃkrāntiḥ makarāt mithunāntām // abhts_6.21 tatra pratyaṅgulaṃ pañca tithayaḥ tatrāpi dinarātrivibhāgaḥ evaṃ praveśe dakṣiṇāyanaṃ garbhatvam udbhavecchā udbubhūṣutā udbhaviṣyatvam udbhavārambhaḥ udbhavattā janmādivikāraṣaṭkaṃ ca iti kramāt makarādiṣu iti // abhts_6.22 tathaiva upāsā atra phalaṃ samucitaṃ karoti // abhts_6.23 atra ca dakṣādyāḥ pitāmahāntā rudrāḥ śaktayaś ca dvādaśādhipataya iti varṣodayaḥ // abhts_6.24 pratyaṅgulaṃ ṣaṣṭiḥ tithaya iti krameṇa saṃkrāntau varṣam ity anena krameṇa praveśanirgamayoḥ dvādaśābdodayaḥ pratyaṅgulaṃ tithīnāṃ śatatrayaṃ sapañcāṃśe 'ṅgule varṣaṃ yatra prāk caṣakam uktam iti gaṇanayā saṃkrāntau pañca varṣāṇi iti anayā paripāṭyā ekasmin prāṇanirgamapraveśakāle ṣaṣṭyabdodayaḥ atra ekaviṃśatisahasrāṇi ṣaṭ śatāni iti tithīnāṃ saṃkhyā // abhts_6.25 tāvatī eva ahorātre prāṇasaṃkhyā iti na ṣaṣṭyabdodayāt adhikaṃ parīkṣyate ānantyāt // abhts_6.26 tatra mānuṣaṃ varṣaṃ devānāṃ tithiḥ anena krameṇa divyāni dvādaśavarṣasahasrāṇi caturyugam // abhts_6.27 catvāri trīṇi dve ekam iti kṛtāt prabhṛti tāvadbhiḥ śataiḥ aṣṭau saṃdhyāḥ // abhts_6.28 caturyugānām ekasaptatyā manvantaram manvantaraiḥ caturdaśabhiḥ brāhmaṃ dinaṃ brahmadinānte kālāgnidagdhe lokatraye anyatra ca lokatraye dhūmaprasvāpite sarve janā vegavad agnipreritā janaloke pralayākalībhūya tiṣṭhanti // abhts_6.29 prabuddhās tu kūṣmāṇḍahāṭakeśādyā maholoke krīḍanti // abhts_6.30 tato niśāsamāptau brāhmī sṛṣṭiḥ // abhts_6.31 anena mānena varṣaśataṃ brahmāyuḥ // abhts_6.32 tat viṣṇoḥ dinaṃ tāvatī ca rātriḥ tasyāpi śatam āyuḥ // abhts_6.33 tat dinaṃ tadūrdhve rudralokaprabho rudrasya tāvatī rātriḥ prāgvat varṣaṃ tacchatam api ca avadhiḥ // abhts_6.34 tatra rudrasya tadavasitau śivatvagatiḥ rudrasya uktādhikārāvadhiḥ brahmāṇḍadhārakāṇāṃ tat dinaṃ śatarudrāṇāṃ niśā tāvatī teṣām api ca śatam āyuḥ // abhts_6.35 śatarudrakṣaye brahmāṇḍavināśaḥ // abhts_6.36 evaṃ jalatattvāt avyaktāntam etad eva krameṇa rudrāṇām āyuḥ // abhts_6.37 pūrvasyāyur uttarasya dinam iti // abhts_6.38 tataś ca brahmā rudrāś ca abādyadhikāriṇaḥ avyakte tiṣṭhanti iti // abhts_6.39 śrīkaṇṭhanāthaś ca tadā saṃhartā // abhts_6.40 eṣo 'vāntarapralayaḥ tatkṣaye sṛṣṭiḥ // abhts_6.41 tatra śāstrāntaram uktā api sṛjyante // abhts_6.42 yat tu śrīkaṇṭhanāthasya svam āyuḥ tat kañcukavāsināṃ rudrāṇāṃ dinaṃ tāvatī rajanī teṣāṃ yad āyuḥ tat gahaneśadinaṃ tāvatī eva kṣapā tasyāṃ ca samastam eva māyāyāṃ vilīyate // abhts_6.43

chunks.l2:
[tsa-a06-v44] Again Gahaneśa emits.

[tsa-a06-v45] Thus which unmanifest-time — having multiplied it by ten half-highests one should tell Māyā-day, that much the night.

[tsa-a06-v47] Māyā-time multiplied by a hundred half-highests is a day in Īśvara-principle.

[tsa-a06-v48] Here breath emits the world, that much the night. Where breath-quiet — even in breath and in Brahman-cave-abode, in the quiet, which consciousness — even there is sequence.

[tsa-a06-v49] In Īśvara time multiplied by a hundred half-highests, whatever the number — that is Sadāśiva day, that much the night; that alone is the great dissolution.

[tsa-a06-v50] Sadāśiva, when own time ends, having ascended drop-half-moon-blocker, dissolves in resonance; resonance in power-principle, that in the pervader, and she in the Unsupported.

[tsa-a06-v51] By power-time multiplied by ten-million half-highests — Unsupported-day.

[tsa-a06-v52] The Unsupported in the like-minded station — which, that likeness, sameness; that is Brahman.

[tsa-a06-v53] From this likeness, from the partless, from time, by mere winking measure — the stated wheel-whirl rise of all time's spread and re-dissolution.

[tsa-a06-v54] One, ten, hundred, thousand, ten thousand, hundred thousand, million, ten million, hundred million, billion, ten billion, hundred billion, thousand billion, ten-thousand billion, ocean, end, middle, half-highest — thus in order ten-multiplied, eighteen: thus the counting-rule.

[tsa-a06-v55] Thus countless emissions-dissolutions in one great-emission-formed breath — it too in consciousness, she in the adjunct, it in bare awareness, of bare awareness alone this pulse which is called this time-rise.

[tsa-a06-v56] From that alone, in dream-fancy and the rest, variety of this brings no contradiction.

[tsa-a06-v57] Thus as in out-breath is time-rise, so too in in-breath, from the heart to the root-seat's end.

[tsa-a06-v58] And as in heart-throat-palate-brow-cleft-twelve-ends the six causes called Brahmā-Viṣṇu-Rudra-Īśa-Sadāśiva-Unsupported, just so too in in-breath, in heart-bulb-bliss-contraction-expansion-twelve-ends — these childhood-youth-age-rebirth-release lords.

[tsa-a06-v59] Now in equal-breath is time-rise.

[tsa-a06-v60] The equal-breath, moving in the ten heart-channels, conveys juices and the rest evenly through the whole body. There moving in the eight directions, it imitates as it were the regents' doings of the knower.

[tsa-a06-v61] But moving up and down, in three channels it does going-coming.

[tsa-a06-v62] There on equinox-day, outside, at dawn-time, a ghaṭikā and a quarter it carries in the middle path.

[tsa-a06-v63] Then nine hundred breath-castings — thus by counting, outside two and a half ghaṭikās — left, right, left, right, left — thus five passages.

[tsa-a06-v64] Then when the five-passage has elapsed, in less-a-quarter fourteen passed ghaṭikās, at southern autumnal equinox-midday, nine breath-hundreds.

[tsa-a06-v65] Then too right, left, right, left, right — thus a five-passage, nine hundred each — thus even at night — thus.

[tsa-a06-v66] Thus on equinox-day and its night, twelve and twelve passages.

[tsa-a06-v67] Then in day wax-wane, passage wax-wane.

[tsa-a06-v68] Thus in one equal-breath-wind two years, from absence of in-out-breath union.

[tsa-a06-v69] Even here twelve-year-rise and the rest as before.

[tsa-a06-v70] But in up-breath the course is twelve-end-limited, of mere-pulse-natured time.

punaḥ gahaneśaḥ sṛjati // abhts_6.44 evaṃ yaḥ avyaktakālaḥ taṃ daśabhiḥ parārdhaiḥ guṇayitvā māyādinaṃ kathayet tāvatī rātriḥ // abhts_6.45 sa eva pralayaḥ // abhts_6.46 māyākālaḥ parārdhaśatena guṇita aiśvaratattve dinam // abhts_6.47 atra prāṇo jagat sṛjati tāvatī rātriḥ yatra prāṇapraśamaḥ prāṇe ca brahmabiladhāmni śānte 'pi yā saṃvit tatrāpy asti kramaḥ // abhts_6.48 aiśvare kāle parārdhaśataguṇite yā saṃkhyā tat sādāśivaṃ dinaṃ tāvatī niśā sa eva mahāpralayaḥ // abhts_6.49 sadāśivaḥ svakālaparikṣaye bindvardhacandranirodhikā ākramya nāde līyate nādaḥ śaktitattve tat vyāpinyāṃ sā ca anāśrite // abhts_6.50 śaktikālena parārdhakoṭiguṇitena anāśritadinam // abhts_6.51 anāśritaḥ sāmanase pade yat tat sāmanasyaṃ sāmyaṃ tat brahma // abhts_6.52 asmāt sāmanasyāt akalyāt kālāt nimeṣonmeṣamātratayā proktāśeṣakālaprasarapravilayacakrabhramodayaḥ // abhts_6.53 ekaṃ daśa śataṃ sahasram ayutaṃ lakṣaṃ niyutaṃ koṭiḥ arbudaṃ vṛndaṃ kharvaṃ nikharvaṃ padmaṃ śaṅkuḥ samudram antyaṃ madhyam parārdham iti krameṇa daśaguṇitāni aṣṭādaśa iti gaṇitavidhiḥ // abhts_6.54 evam asaṃkhyāḥ sṛṣṭipralayāḥ ekasmin mahāsṛṣṭirūpe prāṇe so 'pi saṃvidi sā upādhau sa cinmātre cinmātrasyaiva ayaṃ spando yad ayaṃ kālodayo nāma // abhts_6.55 tata eva svapnasaṃkalpādau vaicitryam asya na virodhāvaham // abhts_6.56 evaṃ yathā prāṇe kālodayaḥ tathā apāne 'pi hṛdayāt mūlapīṭhaparyantam // abhts_6.57 yathā ca hṛtkaṇṭhatālulalāṭarandhradvādaśānteṣu brahmaviṣṇurudreśasadāśivānāśritākhyaṃ kāraṇaṣaṭkam tathaiva apāne 'pi hṛtkandānandasaṃkocavikāsadvādaśānteṣu bālyayauvanavārddhakanidhanapunarbhavamuktyadhipataya ete // abhts_6.58 atha samāne kālodayaḥ // abhts_6.59 samāno hārdīṣu daśāsu nāḍīṣu saṃcaran samaste dehe sāmyena rasādīn vāhayati /
tatra digaṣṭake saṃcaran taddikpaticeṣṭām iva pramātuḥ anukārayati // abhts_6.60 ūrdhvādhas tu saṃcaran tisṛṣu nāḍīṣu gatāgataṃ karoti // abhts_6.61 tatra viṣuvaddine bāhye prabhātakāle sapādāṃ ghaṭikāṃ madhyamārge vahati // abhts_6.62 tato navaśatāni prāṇavikṣepāṇām iti gaṇanayā bahiḥ sārdhaghaṭikādvayaṃ vāme dakṣiṇe vāme dakṣiṇe vāme iti pañca saṃkrāntayaḥ // abhts_6.63 tataḥ saṃkrāntipañcake vṛtte pādonāsu caturdaśasu ghaṭikāsu atikrāntāsu dakṣiṇaṃ śāradaṃ viṣuvanmadhyāhne nava prāṇaśatāni // abhts_6.64 tato 'pi dakṣiṇe vāme dakṣiṇe vāme dakṣiṇe iti saṃkrāntipañcakaṃ pratyekaṃ navaśatāni ity evaṃ rātrāv api iti // abhts_6.65 evaṃ viṣuvaddivase tadrātrau ca dvādaśa dvādaśa saṃkrāntayaḥ // abhts_6.66 tato dinavṛddhikṣayeṣu saṃkrāntivṛddhikṣayaḥ // abhts_6.67 evam ekasmin samānamaruti varṣadvayaṃ śvāsapraśvāsayogābhāvāt // abhts_6.68 atrāpi dvādaśābdodayādi pūrvavat // abhts_6.69 udāne tu dvādaśāntāvadhiś cāraḥ spandamātrātmanaḥ kālasya // abhts_6.70

chunks.l2:
[tsa-a06-v71] Even here as before the rule.

[tsa-a06-v72] But in pervading-breath, from pervasiveness, even in non-sequence, by subtle-surging-ness is time-rise.

[tsa-a06-v74] There in half-watch, in half-watch, class-rise is even at equinox; of the letter, of the letter, two hundred sixteen breaths; outside thirty-six caṣakas: thus this rise, effortless-born letter-rise.

[tsa-a06-v75] But effort-born is mantra-rise: like a water-wheel-device drawing, by single-attention force — wondrous mantra-rise day and night keeping joined — with the mantra-deity gains identity.

[tsa-a06-v76] There in the ever-arisen, by breath-course count alone is rise-count explained; when that doubled, its half, and the rest in order; in the hundred-and-eight wheel, two hundred the rise: thus in order. In gross-subtle course-nature of the rested one, when breath-course has thinned, when time is devoured come about, complete, one, just this awareness, wonder-power-filled, shines.

[tsa-a06-v77] Time-difference alone divides awareness, not object-difference — like peak-abiding knowledge. Of knowing, as much as the abiding-time, that alone is the moment. And in one breath-rise, one knowing alone necessarily — and this: otherwise there would be no single thought-knowing at all, since word-sequenced-stained, since even the measure is sequential.

[tsa-a06-v78] Which has said: the raised, half-short — thus.

[tsa-a06-v79] Therefore until between pulses has not arisen, so long one knowing alone.

[tsa-a06-v80] Hence very eighty-one, when remembering the word, through entering various natures — that one alone, having the Lord as object, that thought, when time is devoured, results as thought-free-natured alone — thus.

[tsa-a06-v81] Thus seeing the entire time-course in breath-rise alone, and the various countless emissions-dissolutions, noting right there, by self alone recognizing lordship — one is freed alone — thus.

[tsa-a06-v82] Seeing the awareness-formed self's breath-power, the form going there and beyond time together, with emission-stay-dissolution wheels, ever-ready attains Bhairavī-being.

atrāpi pūrvavat vidhiḥ // abhts_6.71 vyāne tu vyāpakatvāt akrame 'pi sūkṣmocchalattāyogena kālodayaḥ // abhts_6.72 atha varṇodayaḥ // abhts_6.73 tatra ardhaprahare ardhaprahare vargodayo viṣuvati samaḥ varṇasya varṇasya dve śate ṣoḍaśādhike prāṇānām bahiḥ ṣaṭtriṃśat caṣakāṇi iti udayaḥ ayam ayatnajo varṇodayaḥ // abhts_6.74 yatnajas tu mantrodayaḥ araghaṭṭaghaṭīyantravāhanavat ekānusaṃdhibalāt citraṃ mantrodayaṃ divāniśam anusaṃdadhat mantradevatayā saha tādātmyam eti // abhts_6.75 tatra sadodite prāṇacārasaṃkhyayaiva udayasaṃkhyā vyākhyātā taddviguṇite tadardham ityādi krameṇa aṣṭottaraśate cakre dviśata udayaḥ iti krameṇa sthūlasūkṣme cārasvarūpe viśrāntasya prāṇacāre kṣīṇe kālagrāse vṛtte sampūrṇām ekam evedaṃ saṃvedanaṃ citraśaktinirbharaṃ bhāsate // abhts_6.76 kālabheda eva saṃvedanabhedakaḥ na vedyabhedaḥ śikharasthajñānavat jñānasya yāvān avasthitikālaḥ sa eva kṣaṇaḥ prāṇodaye ca ekasmin ekam eva jñānam avaśyaṃ caitat anyathā vikalpajñānam ekaṃ na kiṃcit syāt kramikaśabdārūṣitatvāt mātrāyā api kramikatvāt // abhts_6.77 yad āha tasyādita udāttam ardhahrasvam iti // abhts_6.78 tasmāt spandāntaraṃ yāvat na uditaṃ tāvat ekam eva jñānam // abhts_6.79 ata eva ekāśīti padasmaraṇasamaye vividhadharmānupraveśamukhena eka eva asau parameśvaraviṣayo vikalpaḥ kālagrāse na avikalpātmā eva sampadyate iti // abhts_6.80 evam akhilaṃ kālādhvānaṃ prāṇodaya eva paśyan sṛṣṭisaṃhārāṃś ca vicitrān niḥsaṃkhyān tatraiva ākalayan ātmana eva pārameśvaryaṃ pratyabhijānan mukta eva bhavati iti // abhts_6.81 saṃvidrūpasyātmanaḥ prāṇaśaktiṃ paśyan rūpaṃ tatragaṃ cātikālam /
sākaṃ sṛṣṭisthemasaṃhāracakrair nityodyukto bhairavībhāvam eti // abhts_6.82
